title: Mission Control projects
description: The projects the collector writes a snapshot for (#99), in the order of the settings. The web app reads this list instead of a hard-coded one; each project's snapshot is <id>/snapshot.json next to this file.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this contract. Bumped only for breaking changes.

id.description: Unique; also the folder of the project's files and the first part of its URL (e.g. mission-control).
